title: 音楽・音響情報処理
subtitle: Acoustical and Musical Processing
keywords: Music synthesizer 2.Fourier synthesis 3.Music sequencer 4.Automatic music performance 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: In this course, students will: (1) Learn the mechanisms for synthesis of sound in a musical synthesizer and automatic performance methods through MATLAB programming. (2) Learn the physical characteristics of sound and methods for the input or output of sound. (3) Consider the impressions of sound created by programming. (4) Discuss application of the contents for regional cooperation.
advice: In this course, the mechanism for Fourier synthesis in a musical synthesizer and method for automatic performance will be examine based on the knowledge imparted in “Media Informatics I”. In a part of the course, students will learn and practice how to create sound or music work via MATLAB programming. Students are expected to review the contents of “Media Informatics I” and other courses related to computer programming.
requiredKnowledge: An understanding of the course “Media Informatics I” is required. Basic computer programming skills are required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand how sound is represented in a computer.
Be able to understand the relationship between sound timber and Fourier synthesis.
Be able to understand the relationship between temporal characteristics of sound loudness and time envelopes.
Be able to recreate an imagined sound via MATLAB programming.
Be able to present an automatic music performance via MATLAB programming.
Be able to create original sound or music.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Be able to explain how sound is represented in a computer. (2) Be able to explain the mechanism for sound synthesis with principles of Fourier synthesis. (3) Be able to imagine a method for representing an envisioned sound or music via MATLAB programming. (4) Be able to create a piece of sound or music that shows good quality.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Be able to understand how sound is represented in a computer. (2) Be able to understand principles of Fourier synthesis. (3) Be able to partially represent an envisioned sound or music using an exemplified program. (4) Be able to create a piece of sound or music.

lessons.content: Course introduction Chapter 1 “Basis of MATLAB” -Matrix calculation -Built-in function and User-defined function
Chapter 2 “Method for Synthesis of Sound” -Representation of sound in computer -Sampling theorem and Aliasing -Create pure sound
Chapter 2 “Method for Synthesis of Sound” -Synthesis of two pure tones
Chapter 3 “Fourier Synthesis and Fourier Analysis” -Fourier series of square wave, sawtooth wave and triangle wave. -Fourier synthesis of square wave
Chapter 3 “Fourier Synthesis and Fourier Analysis” -Fourier synthesis of sawtooth wave and triangle wave
Chapter 3 “Fourier Synthesis and Fourier Analysis” -Synthesis of sound using “fourier_synthesis” function
Chapter 3 “Fourier Synthesis and Fourier Analysis” -Fourier analysis of complex tone
Chapter 3 “Fourier Synthesis and Fourier Analysis” -Recording using microphone
Chapter 4 “Time Envelope” -Basis of time envelope -Control for temporal characteristics of sound pressure level
Chapter 4 “Time Envelope” -Control for temporal characteristics of sound pressure level
Chapter 5 “Music Sequencer” -Implement music sequencer in a Fourier synthesizer
lessons.assignments: Lecture review Prepare for the exam including the assignment sheet
Write a paper about the experiment

lessons.content: Exam Comprehensive practice 1 -Create work of sound or music
Comprehensive practice 2 -Create work of sound or music
